run_clang_tidy_on_hpp_files: run clang-tidy on all hpp header files in the boost histogram include directory using a thread pool
run_tidy_single_file: run clang-tidy on a single hpp file and return the command and output report
detect_clang_tidy_version: detect the highest available clang-tidy version from 15 down to 6 on the system
review_boost_histogram_headers: review boost histogram header files for static analysis issues using clang-tidy in parallel
summarize_tidy_output: summarize the clang-tidy output report for each hpp file that has findings
